review.note: APPROVE T195 (W5 A2), my own build + run, logs in node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a2r/. Ran (pinned node 22.23.3, private port 1842): vite build ok (build.log); vitest dragReorder.test.ts 31 passed (unit.log); playwright 118 passed 0 failed in 12.4m over drag-reorder, sidebar-selection, appearance, writing, alignment, fragments-panel, research-library, layout PLUS split-view, scrollspy, research-pdf (pw.log); tsc --noEmit exit 0 (tsc.log); grep for Move up/down/ArrowUp size/ArrowDown size in ProjectSidebar.tsx: no match. Code vs plan: no arrow buttons; nth-child(-n+2) rule removed; Bibliography fixed first row, no drag/chord; source+PDF is one .entry-unit, chord only on source row; each of sources/notes/fragments/manuscript/groups has its own useDragReorder so no cross-sublist drags; keyboardMove ignores Alt+any other modifier; chord sets no data-drag-state (spec asserts 0 drag-state); live region .visually-hidden role=status inside .sidebar; focus restored via data-row-id (specs assert toBeFocused after each move); App uses mutate: fragments via reorderKind (other kinds keep slots), sources/notes via moveWithin on research arrays; search-filtered chord maps via all.indexOf(next) (spec passes). No new hover/scale/stroke rules or fills in the diff. A1 icon contract (detail NOTE_KINDS) kept. Fail-first: failfirst-unit.log = 11 TypeError 'is not a function' for the new helpers (20 old pass); failfirst-pw.log on pre-A2 build = 6 new specs fail for right reasons (10 Move buttons found, no lifted state on fragment drag, no .entry-unit, chord leaves order unchanged), not timeouts. Persistence: specs reorder a fragment (drag), source+PDF and note (drag), and by chord fragment/source/note/section/group, then page.reload() and re-assert order. Declared departures judged: (1) keeping .group-actions button in icon lists = right, view toggle and add button live there; (2) keeping .reorder wrapper for open-beside = acceptable, split-view.spec.ts:384 needs it, harmless naming debt, rename later; (3) deleted alignment hit-area-overlap spec = fine, it tested adjacent arrows that no longer exist. Screenshots (own, 16 PNGs in ui5-a2r/shots, all opened, light/dark x Plain/Color): no-arrows-*: hovered Manuscript row shows only open-beside + spy line, Research rows Bibliography/source/pdf/notes icon-aligned, no arrows. research-hover-*: Research heading hovered shows only view toggle + add, nothing hidden. chord-focus-*: after Alt+Down, Frag one is second, accent focus ring on it, palette tints intact. drag-midflight-*: Alpha unit with alpha.pdf lifted under Beta, 2px accent drop line, indentation and icons aligned (A1 alignment holds with sublist wrappers). ACCESSIBILITY FINDING (confirmed): setAnnouncement(sameString) is a React no-op, so a repeated identical announcement leaves the live region DOM unchanged. My MutationObserver probe: pressing Alt+Down three times on an already-last fragment gave 1 mutation total, text unchanged. Severity: LOW, approve-with-follow-up not reject. Only the 'X is already first/last' message can repeat back-to-back; every real move text includes a changing position so it differs each time (and the same item cannot repeat the same position consecutively); the plan requirement that every move is announced is met; screen readers also still read the focused row. Follow-up (small): in chord(), clear then set on next frame (setAnnouncement(''); requestAnimationFrame(()=>setAnnouncement(msg))) or toggle a trailing zero-width space on each call, plus a spec on a repeated 'already last'. Other caveats: native WebKit not checked (display:contents sublists hit-testing; plan fallback is block wrapper), VoiceOver not tested, cards view with source unit as one grid cell not viewed; tsc was clean so no other agents' in-flight breakage seen.

log.note:
T195 (W5 A2) CLAIMED, not VERIFIED. No commits.
WHAT CHANGED
- ProjectSidebar.tsx: group and row up/down arrow buttons removed (ArrowUp/ArrowDown imports gone). Drag now covers groups, sections, fragments (new fragmentDrag over the search-filtered list, mapped to the index among all fragments), research sources and notes. Research renders Bibliography as a fixed first row, then .entry-sublist[data-list="sources"] of .entry-unit (source row + its PDF row, one draggable unit) and .entry-sublist[data-list="notes"]; each sublist has its own useDragReorder; drags never cross sublists. Rows are partitioned from collectionItems (id "bibliography"; "pdf:<sourceId>"; note = detail in NOTE_KINDS; else source) so the A1 icon contract is unchanged. Option+Up/Down (keyboardMove) on the focused .entry-main (sections, fragments, sources, notes) and on the three collapsible .group-title buttons moves the item past its visible neighbour, at once (no drag state); one .visually-hidden role=status live region in .sidebar says "Moved <title> to position <n> of <total>" or "<title> is already first/last"; focus returns to [data-row-id] after re-render. Bibliography, PDF rows and bottom rows ignore the chord. New props onReorderFragment, onReorderResearch.
- dragReorder.ts: moveWithin (reorder with clamped target), reorderKind (other kinds keep their slots), keyboardMove. useDragReorder.ts untouched (works per sublist via display:contents wrappers).
- App.tsx: reorderFragment (reorderKind on entries via mutate) and reorderResearch (moveWithin on research.sources/notes), passed to the sidebar.
- styles.css: removed the 9 ".reorder button" entries from the icon lists, the arrow gap on .reorder, the @container nth-child(-n + 2) trap; added .entry-sublist {display: contents} and .cards-view .entry-unit {display: grid; gap: var(--space-2)}.
DEVIATIONS (msg'd to agent-2a1b): ".group-actions button" kept in all icon lists (view toggle and add button still live there); the .reorder wrapper class + its reveal CSS kept for the open-beside button because tests/split-view.spec.ts:384 (not mine) queries it; alignment "reorder arrows keep hit areas from overlapping" test deleted (no arrows left, no replacement); appearance.spec disabled-arrow opacity assertion replaced by an arrows-absent count; appearance icon-colour check retargeted to .open-beside; sidebar-selection "Move down is disabled" replaced by an Option+Down "already last" spec; writing.spec Move-up click replaced by Alt+ArrowUp. Registered src/components/dragReorder.test.ts (plan lists it; was missing).
STEP 1 grep: no consumer depends on source/note/fragment array order for behaviour (display/tie-break only; withCommentRevisions matches by id); no Alt+Arrow shortcut in registry. See ui5-a2/grep-step1.txt.
SEMANTICS: with a search active, the chord moves past the visible neighbour; the announced position is in the full list.
ACCEPTANCE (all under node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-a2/, port 1840, private build, 1 worker, no retries):
- vitest dragReorder.test.ts: 31 passed (acceptance-unit.log)
- playwright drag-reorder, sidebar-selection, appearance, writing, alignment, fragments-panel, research-library, layout: 79 passed, 0 failed (acceptance-pw.log)
- grep "Move .* up|Move .* down|ArrowUp size|ArrowDown size" ProjectSidebar.tsx: no match (acceptance-grep.log); before: 8 matches (grep-before.txt)
- tsc --noEmit: exit 0 (tsc.log); vite build exit 0 (build-after.log); hoverEmphasis/designTokens/motion/dragReorder unit guards 67 passed (unit-guards.log)
FAIL-FIRST: failfirst-unit.log (11 new unit tests fail, 20 old pass); failfirst-pw.log on the pre-A2 build: 6 new/changed specs fail for the expected reasons (arrows found=10, no lift on fragment drag, no .entry-unit, chord does nothing); 1 pre-existing test passed because the -g filter matched it.
SCREENSHOTS (ui5-a2/shots, all 12 opened):
- no-arrows-{light,dark}-{plain,color}: hovered Manuscript row shows only open-beside + spy line, no arrows; Research rows aligned with icons.
- drag-midflight-*: Alpha source unit with its alpha.pdf row lifted below Beta, 2 px accent drop line under Beta. The accent-coloured alpha.pdf text is the existing .sidebar .entry-main:active press rule (styles.css ~2076), not new CSS.
- chord-focus-*: after Option+Down "Frag one" is second with the focus ring on it; Color palette tints intact.
UNVERIFIED: native WebKit (hit-testing through display:contents sublists; plan fallback is a block wrapper); cards view at >=380 px with a source unit as one grid cell (not viewed); VoiceOver reading; an identical repeated announcement is not re-read. No graphify graph in this project.
